title: add add/copy --required-path

> /kind feature

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
required paths lets callers assert that specific paths are present among the files matched by --include. failing the copy instead of silently producing an incomplete result if an include pattern stops matching an expected path. Must be used with --include


#### How to verify it
`sudo bats --show-output-of-passing-tests tests/add.bats -f "required-path"`
`bats --show-output-of-passing-tests tests/copy.bats -f "required-path"`

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
Fixes #6986
Part of #6732
